name: ari-marketplace
description: Arijit's personal Claude Code marketplace — reference and tooling plugins for the frameworks I work in.

plugins.name: remix
plugins.description: Comprehensive Remix v3 reference for Claude Code. Progressive-disclosure sub-skills covering every layer of the framework — routing, controllers, database, validation, auth, security, sessions, middleware, forms, UI components, build pipeline, testing, scaffolders, and more. Two runnable example apps. Full topic list in the plugin's own plugin.json.

plugins.name: electrobun
plugins.description: Complete Electrobun toolkit for Claude Code: skill + embedded MCP server. Main SKILL.md + 9 sub-skills (scaffold, views, ipc-rpc, build-dist, updater, webgpu, system-integration, architecture, zig-main). Plus 16 MCP tools to drive your running app — 9 CDP tools for webview (list views, eval, navigate, reload, screenshot, dom, console, network, devtools) and 7 bridge tools for bun-side (list windows, rpc log, ffi log, bun_eval [gated], updater state, app log, native log [Windows]). Bridge requires `bun add -d electrobun-devtools` in your app. Source-grounded against upstream blackboardsh/electrobun with live deepwiki + context7 fallback.
